borough: London Borough of Barking and Dagenham
description: Conversion of the existing detached annex into a 1x bed dwelling
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be commenced before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

<p>The development hereby approved shall only be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:</p><ul><li>Site Plan - drawing no.&nbsp; 0652_00_001 - dated August 2025</li><li>Proposed Elevations - drawing no.&nbsp; 0652_00_101 - dated August 2025</li><li>Proposed Ground Floor Plan - drawing no.&nbsp; 0652_00_102a - dated August 2025</li><li>Proposed Roof Floor Plan - drawing no.&nbsp; 0652_00_106 - dated August 2025</li><li>Location Plan - drawing no.&nbsp; 0652_00_010 - dated August 2025</li><li>Design and Access Statement</li><li>Sustainability Statement</li><li>Transport Statement</li></ul><p>No other drawings or documents apply.</p>

<p>The proposed development shall achieve Secured by design principles to the satisfaction of the local 
authority &amp; Metropolitan Police, details of which shall be provided to the Local Planning Authority for 
its written approval prior to the first occupation of the approved development. All security measures 
applied to the approved development shall be permanently retained thereafter</p>
